description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures for certain hardware boards, including enabling image metadata checks, validating image compatibility, performing the upgrade, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Sets the REQUIRE_IMAGE_METADATA variable if the board matches specific models to enable image metadata verification during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current board supports the sysupgrade process, returns success if supported, otherwise displays a message.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by writing the new image directly to the disk device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to the appropriate partition on the device.
